verdict.rationale: Bento's broadcasts doc explicitly states the API can be used to review broadcast history, create campaigns, and schedule approved sends with explicit audience rules, and authentication uses simple HTTP Basic auth with publishable/secret keys, all documented publicly without needing the dashboard. The CLI and MCP integrations further confirm broadcast creation is exposed programmatically. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of a full end-to-end API call sequence (create+schedule) and no OpenAPI spec found to verify exact request/response shape.
